blurb: Guests rent kayaks or paddleboards and explore Seattle's Portage Bay, Lake Union, and the Arboretum water trails. Guided tours and group reservations are available for various group sizes. Wildlife viewing and cityscape sights are common on the water.
extraNote: 50% deposit required for large group reservations · Late arrivals can delay launch but return time is fixed; late participants cannot launch separately · Reservation changes must be requested at least two weeks in advance · Agua Verde Paddle Club docks on Portage Bay
